# agentgateway_llm_provider (Resource)

Reusable LLM provider defaults that models reference by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Built-in provider with a model and an environment-referenced credential.
# The gateway resolves "$OPENAI_API_KEY" at runtime; the key never lands in
# Terraform state.
resource "agentgateway_llm_provider" "openai" {
  name          = "openai-prod"
  provider_name = "openAI"
  model         = "gpt-4o"
  api_key       = "$OPENAI_API_KEY"
  base_url      = "https://api.openai.com"
}

# Preset provider. Presets carry their own upstream defaults; only the
# credential and the region-specific parameters are set here.
resource "agentgateway_llm_provider" "deepseek" {
  name          = "deepseek-eu"
  provider_name = "deepseek"
  model         = "deepseek-chat"
  api_key       = "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
}

# A provider that inherits another entry by name. Models can reference either
# entry; this one only overrides the model.
resource "agentgateway_llm_provider" "openai_mini" {
  name               = "openai-mini"
  provider_reference = agentgateway_llm_provider.openai.name
  model              = "gpt-4o-mini"
}

# A self-hosted provider, expressed as JSON because the custom provider shape
# is an escape hatch for anything the typed attributes do not cover.
resource "agentgateway_llm_provider" "self_hosted" {
  name = "self-hosted"

  custom_provider_json = jsonencode({
    model            = "llama3"
    providerOverride = "vllm"
    formats = [
      { type = "completions" },
    ]
  })

  base_url = "http://vllm.internal:8000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Provider entry name. Models reference it with `provider_reference`.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Upstream credential (`params.apiKey`). Supports `$ENV` references and `{file: …}`.
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region for `bedrock` (`params.awsRegion`).
- `azure_api_version` (String) Azure API version (`params.azureApiVersion`).
- `azure_project_name` (String) Azure project name (`params.azureProjectName`).
- `azure_resource_name` (String) Azure resource name (`params.azureResourceName`).
- `azure_resource_type` (String) Azure resource type (`params.azureResourceType`).
- `base_url` (String) Upstream base URL (`params.baseUrl`).
- `custom_provider_json` (String) Custom provider as JSON, `{model, providerOverride, formats}`. Exactly one of `provider_name`, `provider_reference` or `custom_provider_json` must be set.
- `defaults_json` (String) Provider defaults as JSON: `defaults`, `overrides`, `transformations`, TLS, auth and health.
- `host_override` (String) Upstream host override (`params.hostOverride`).
- `model` (String) Upstream model id (`params.model`).
- `path_override` (String) Upstream path override (`params.pathOverride`).
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix to strip before forwarding (`params.pathPrefix`).
- `provider_name` (String) Built-in or preset provider name. Exactly one of `provider_name`, `provider_reference` or `custom_provider_json` must be set.
- `provider_reference` (String) Name of another provider entry to inherit from. Exactly one of `provider_name`, `provider_reference` or `custom_provider_json` must be set.
- `tokenize` (Boolean) Ask the gateway to tokenize requests for this provider (`params.tokenize`).
- `vertex_project` (String) Vertex AI project (`params.vertexProject`).
- `vertex_region` (String) Vertex AI region (`params.vertexRegion`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider name as stored by the gateway.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision of the provider.
